annotations.title: PII detection and redaction: emails, phones, cards, IBANs

description: Find personal data in a text and get it back redacted: emails, phone numbers, card numbers (Luhn-checked), IBANs (mod-97), US SSNs, IP and crypto wallet addresses, each with its position, plus the text with every hit replaced by a label such as [EMAIL]. Hits are shown masked. Up to 20,000 characters; names and street addresses are not detected. Use before logging, storing or sending text to a model. Example: text=Contact Anna at anna.berg@example.com or +46 70 123 45 67; card 4111 1111 1111 1111.. Price $0.01/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.

text.description: The text to scan (up to 20,000 characters)

types.description: Optional comma-separated types to look for: email, iban, credit_card, us_ssn, crypto_address, ip_address, phone (default all)
